label: Galaxy Z Flip5 foldable smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip5 — clamshell foldable with a 6.7-inch inner display, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6/mmWave; USB-C port, no DeX.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz + mmWave (US SKUs). Flip5 has no Samsung DeX, so a USB-C dock gives USB tethering plus Ethernet via adapter only — attenuate usb0 expectations in dock scenarios. Folding chassis means antenna placement changes with lid state; the simulator can model the closed state as a 3-6 dB RSSI penalty.
